description: A Neovim plugin that provides VSCode-style diff rendering with two-tier highlighting, supporting side-by-side and inline layouts.
tagline: VSCode-style side-by-side and inline diff rendering for Neovim

options.label: Layout
options.description: Open diffs in two synchronized panes or one inline unified pane.

options.label: Filler Text
options.description: Text pattern repeated on alignment rows. Use an empty string for blank rows.

options.label: Ignore Trim Whitespace
options.description: Ignore leading and trailing whitespace changes.

options.label: Jump To First Change
options.description: Scroll to the first hunk when opening a diff.

options.label: Disable Inlay Hints
options.description: Disable inlay hints in diff windows for a cleaner view.

options.label: Max Computation Time ms
options.description: Maximum diff computation time in milliseconds.

options.label: Line Insert
options.description: Neovim highlight group name or color used for inserted lines.

options.label: Line Delete
options.description: Neovim highlight group name or color used for deleted lines.

options.label: Char Insert
options.description: Optional highlight group name or color for inserted characters. When omitted, CodeDiff derives it from the line highlight.

options.label: Char Delete
options.description: Optional highlight group name or color for deleted characters. When omitted, CodeDiff derives it from the line highlight.

options.label: Char Brightness
options.description: Optional brightness multiplier used when character highlights are derived automatically.

options.label: Position
options.description: Place the changed-file explorer at the left or bottom.

options.label: Hidden
options.description: Start explorer sessions with the explorer panel hidden.

options.label: Width
options.description: Explorer width in columns when positioned on the left.

options.label: Height
options.description: Explorer height in lines when positioned at the bottom.

options.label: Auto Refresh
options.description: Refresh the changed-file list on focus and Git index changes.

options.label: View Mode
options.description: Show changed files as a flat list or directory tree.

options.label: Initial Focus
options.description: Window focused when an explorer diff session opens.

options.label: Untracked
options.description: Control how Git scans and displays untracked files.

options.label: Focus On Select
options.description: Focus the modified pane after selecting a file.

options.label: Auto Open On Cursor
options.description: Open the explorer file under the cursor while navigating.

options.label: Position
options.description: Place the commit history panel at the left or bottom.

options.label: Width
options.description: History width in columns when positioned on the left.

options.label: Height
options.description: History height in lines when positioned at the bottom.

options.label: Initial Focus
options.description: Window focused when a history diff session opens.

options.label: View Mode
options.description: Show files under commits as a flat list or directory tree.

options.label: Date Format
options.description: Git date format such as %ar, %ai, %ad, or a strftime format.

options.label: Hide Merge Artifacts
options.description: Hide common temporary merge-tool files from comparisons.

options.label: Original Position
options.description: Pane used for the original or old content.

options.label: Cycle Next Hunk
options.description: Wrap hunk navigation at the first and last hunk.

options.label: Cycle Next File
options.description: Wrap file navigation at the first and last file.

options.label: Cycle Hunks Across Files
options.description: Continue hunk navigation into adjacent files in explorer and history modes.

options.label: Highlight Added Deleted Files
options.description: Tint the full contents of added, untracked, and deleted files.

options.label: Highlight Priority
options.description: Priority of line-level diff highlights.

options.label: Compute Moves
options.description: Detect and annotate blocks of code moved within a file.

options.label: Compact
options.description: Open diffs with unchanged regions folded.

options.label: Compact Context Lines
options.description: Number of unchanged context lines shown around hunks in compact mode.

options.label: Compact Sync Folds
options.description: Synchronize fold opening and closing across diff panes.

options.label: Conflict Ours Position
options.description: Pane used for the current or ours side in conflict views.

options.label: Conflict Result Position
options.description: Place the editable result below the diff or between its panes.

options.label: Conflict Result Height
options.description: Result pane height as a percentage in the bottom conflict layout.

options.label: Conflict Result Width Ratio
options.description: Relative widths of the left, center result, and right panes.

options.label: Conflict Sign
options.description: Optional highlight group name or color for unresolved conflict signs.

options.label: Conflict Sign Resolved
options.description: Optional highlight group name or color for resolved conflict signs.

options.label: Conflict Sign Accepted
options.description: Optional highlight group name or color for accepted conflict sides.

options.label: Conflict Sign Rejected
options.description: Optional highlight group name or color for rejected conflict sides.

options.label: Indent markers
options.description: Show directory indent markers in tree view.

options.label: Folder Closed
options.description: Icon used for collapsed folders in tree view.

options.label: Folder Open
options.description: Icon used for expanded folders in tree view.

options.label: Ignore
options.description: Glob and Git pathspec patterns hidden from the explorer.

options.label: Flatten Dirs
options.description: Collapse single-child directory chains in tree view.

options.label: Status Right Margin
options.description: Trailing cells between the status symbol and explorer edge.

options.label: Enabled
options.description: Fetch and display Git insertion and deletion counts.

options.label: Count Untracked
options.description: Count lines in untracked files as insertions.

options.label: Max Untracked Bytes
options.description: Maximum untracked file size in bytes for line counting.

options.label: Ellipsis
options.description: Text appended to truncated explorer regions.

options.label: Staged
options.description: Show staged changes in the explorer.

options.label: Unstaged
options.description: Show unstaged changes in the explorer.

options.label: Conflicts
options.description: Show conflicted files in the explorer.

options.label: File
options.description: Optional Lua function(ctx) that returns the complete file-row layout.

options.label: Folder
options.description: Optional Lua function(ctx) that returns the complete folder-row layout.

options.label: Group
options.description: Optional Lua function(ctx) that returns the complete group-row layout.

options.label: Close On Open In Prev Tab

functions.name: next_hunk
functions.label: Next hunk
functions.description: Navigate to the next hunk in the current diff view.

functions.name: prev_hunk
functions.label: Previous hunk
functions.description: Navigate to the previous hunk in the current diff view.

functions.name: next_file
functions.label: Next file
functions.description: Navigate to the next file in explorer or history mode, or the next commit in single-file history.

functions.name: prev_file
functions.label: Previous file
functions.description: Navigate to the previous file in explorer or history mode, or the previous commit in single-file history.

exCommands.name: CodeDiff
exCommands.label: Open CodeDiff
exCommands.description: Open the CodeDiff UI for Git changes, revisions, files, directories, history, merge conflicts, or library installation.

params.name: range
params.label: Selected line range
params.description: Prefix with '<,'> so history is limited to the current visual selection. Use with the history subcommand.

params.name: layout
params.label: Layout
params.description: Override the configured diff layout for this invocation.

params.name: exit_on_close
params.label: Exit Neovim on close
params.description: Exit Neovim when the CodeDiff session closes; intended for external diff and merge tools.

params.name: repo
params.label: Repository
params.description: Operate on the repository containing this directory. Emits --repo; upstream also accepts -C.

params.name: staged
params.label: Staged changes only
params.description: Compare the Git index with HEAD or the supplied revision. Emits --staged; upstream also accepts --cached.

params.name: subcommand
params.label: Mode
params.description: Choose a CodeDiff mode, or omit it to open repository changes.

allowedValueDescriptions.file: Compare the current file with revisions or compare two files
allowedValueDescriptions.install: Install or update the native diff library
allowedValueDescriptions.install!: Force reinstall the native diff library

params.name: arg1
params.label: First argument
params.description: First revision, file, directory, history range, or merge target, depending on the selected mode.

params.name: arg2
params.label: Second argument
params.description: Second revision, file, directory, or history file filter, depending on the selected mode.

params.name: reverse
params.label: Oldest commits first
params.description: Show history in chronological order. Emits --reverse; upstream also accepts -r.

params.name: base
params.label: History base revision
params.description: Compare every history commit with this fixed revision instead of its parent. Emits --base; upstream also accepts -b.

params.name: pathspec
params.label: Pathspecs
params.description: Git pathspec tokens relative to the repository root. Enter multiple escaped tokens as one free-text value.

exCommandTemplates.label: Open Changes
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Open changed files in the current repository.

exCommandTemplates.label: Open Staged Changes
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Show only changes staged in the Git index.

exCommandTemplates.label: Open Changes Inline
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Open changes using the inline diff layout.

exCommandTemplates.label: Compare Current File with HEAD
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Compare the current file with its HEAD revision.

exCommandTemplates.label: Compare Two Files
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Compare two files from the filesystem.

exCommandTemplates.label: Compare Two Directories
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Compare the contents of two directories.

exCommandTemplates.label: Selected Lines History
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Show commits that changed the selected line range.

exCommandTemplates.label: Resolve Merge Conflict
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Open conflict resolution for a file.

exCommandTemplates.label: Install Diff Library
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Install or update CodeDiff’s native diff library.

exCommandTemplates.label: Reinstall Diff Library
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Force reinstall CodeDiff’s native diff library.
